from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Annotated

from flext_core import m as core_m


class NativeMroConsumerModelsReports:
    """The consumer owns its report declarations in its model family."""

    class Case(core_m.ArbitraryTypesModel):
        """One actual module-level class to check."""

        name: Annotated[str, core_m.Field(description="Consumer case name.")]
        target: Annotated[type, core_m.Field(description="Actual class to check.")]

    class Outcome(core_m.ArbitraryTypesModel):
        """Complete public checker output and actual service result."""

        name: Annotated[str, core_m.Field(description="Consumer case name.")]
        target_module: Annotated[str, core_m.Field(description="Target module.")]
        target_qualname: Annotated[str, core_m.Field(description="Qualified name.")]
        rule_ids: Annotated[
            tuple[str, ...], core_m.Field(description="Public checker rule IDs.")
        ]
        value: Annotated[str | None, core_m.Field(description="Service result.")]

    class Report(core_m.ArbitraryTypesModel):
        """Actual interpreter, source and CWD provenance plus every case."""

        python_prefix: Annotated[Path, core_m.Field(description="Python prefix.")]
        core_service_source: Annotated[
            Path, core_m.Field(description="Loaded native service source path.")
        ]
        cwd: Annotated[Path, core_m.Field(description="Child working directory.")]
        cases: Annotated[
            tuple[NativeMroConsumerModelsReports.Outcome, ...],
            core_m.Field(description="Complete consumer case outcomes."),
        ]

"""Execute real native checks and emit the consumer-owned report."""

from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from flext_core import s as core_s, u

from native_mro_consumer import base
from native_mro_consumer.models import m


class NativeMroConsumerCli:
    """Thin adapter over public checking and actual native services."""

    @staticmethod
    def main() -> int:
        """Execute every case without catching or normalizing native failures."""
        cases = (
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="state", target=base.NativeMroConsumerServiceBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="validated", target=base.NativeMroConsumerValidatedBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="helper", target=base.NativeMroConsumerHelperBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="foreign", target=base.NativeMroConsumerForeignBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="behavior", target=base.NativeMroConsumerBehaviorBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="inherited_behavior",
                target=base.NativeMroConsumerInheritedBehaviorBase,
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="property", target=base.NativeMroConsumerPropertyBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="inherited_foreign",
                target=base.NativeMroConsumerInheritedForeignBase,
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="empty", target=base.NativeMroConsumerEmptyBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="lookalike", target=base.NativeMroConsumerLookalikeBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="shared_foreign", target=base.NativeMroConsumerSharedForeignBase
            ),
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Case(
                name="service_as_state", target=base.NativeMroConsumerServiceAsStateBase
            ),
        )
        values = {
            "state": base.NativeMroConsumerServiceBase().execute().unwrap(),
            "validated": base.NativeMroConsumerValidatedBase().execute().unwrap(),
        }
        outcomes = tuple(
            m.NativeMroConsumer.Outcome(
                name=case.name,
                target_module=case.target.__module__,
                target_qualname=case.target.__qualname__,
                rule_ids=tuple(
                    sorted({v.rule_id for v in u.check(case.target).violations})
                ),
                value=values.get(case.name),
            )
            for case in cases
        )
        report = m.NativeMroConsumer.Report(
            python_prefix=Path(sys.prefix),
            core_service_source=Path(inspect.getfile(core_s)).resolve(),
            cwd=Path.cwd(),
            cases=outcomes,
        )
        sys.stdout.write(report.model_dump_json() + "\n")
        return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(NativeMroConsumerCli.main())
